title: kbmon's sessions panel and status answer give one line per session
goal: the sessions panel's view and kbmon --status sessions print each entry of the sessions list as one line from one function: label, role, sprint short name, item short title, step, elapsed time, last activity and spend when known, at most 120 characters; the answer points to python3 _tools/kbask.py summary for a model summary, which runs only on that request and stays capped by its budget and turns

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
S=[{'label':'s-1a2b3c','role':'worker','item':'ST-aaaaaaaa','item_title':'Plant a worker item whose title is long enough that one line must cut it down to a short title','sprint':'SP-bbbbbbbb','sprint_title':'Plant sprint','step':'land:checks','started':'2026-10-19T07:00:00Z','last_activity':'2026-10-19T07:40:00Z','spend_usd':1.25},
   {'label':'s-4d5e6f','role':'interactive','item':None,'item_title':None,'sprint':None,'sprint_title':None,'step':None,'started':'2026-10-19T06:00:00Z','last_activity':'2026-10-19T07:45:00Z','spend_usd':None}]
snap={'schema':1,'taken':'2026-10-19T08:00:00Z','alerts':[],'panels':{'sessions':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'procs':[],'worktrees':[],'sessions':S}}}}
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'s.json');json.dump(snap,open(f,'w'))
r=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a,'--from-snapshot',f],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='160')).stdout
once=r('--once');st=r('--status','sessions')
rows=[l.strip() for l in st.splitlines() if re.search(r'\bs-[0-9a-f]{6}\b',l)]
print(rows)
ok=(len(rows)==2 and all(len(l)<=120 for l in rows) and 'worker' in rows[0] and 'land:checks' in rows[0] and '$1.25' in rows[0]
    and all(l in once for l in rows) and 'kbask.py summary' in st)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
